name: electron-hello
description: Example Electron app generated by WinForge.
author: WinForge

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:main && electron-builder
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:web && npm run build:main && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.build:macos: npm run build:web && npm run build:main && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:web && npm run build:main && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.package:exe: npm run build:web && npm run build:main && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.package:msi: npm run build:web && npm run build:main && electron-builder --win msi --publish never
scripts.package:dmg: npm run build:web && npm run build:main && electron-builder --mac dmg --publish never
scripts.package:appimage: npm run build:web && npm run build:main && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.package:deb: npm run build:web && npm run build:main && electron-builder --linux deb --publish never
scripts.package:rpm: npm run build:web && npm run build:main && electron-builder --linux rpm --publish never
